title: What We Can Learn from Spotify's Use of Local Marketing Ads | Kraus Marketing

facts.fact: The page reports that people who encountered Spotify ads placed by location-based targeting for Baskin-Robbins visited Baskin-Robbins 430,000 times; the page attributes the analysis to a collaboration with Placed, and the figure is not independently verified here.
facts.quote: The result? Those who encountered the Spotify ads ended up visiting Baskin-Robbins 430,000 times.

facts.fact: The page says Spotify launched a series of state-specific curated playlists in the days before the 2018 Midterm Elections to increase user engagement.
facts.quote: In the days leading up to the 2018 Midterm Elections, Spotify launched a series of specially curated playlists tailored to each individual state

facts.fact: The article was originally published on July 17, 2019.
The article's listed modification date is August 25, 2021.
